articles.t: My Controller Needed Upgrades for GTA 6. Here's What I Added - CNET
articles.chapeau: From simple thumbstick caps to more advanced options, there are several ways to improve your controller for a better GTA 6 experience.
articles.txt:
If you haven’t heard, there’s a pretty big game coming soon that’s poised to shatter sales records set by its predecessor that came out 13 years ago: Grand Theft Auto 6. If you’re planning to play GTA 6, you’ll want to make sure your PS5 or Xbox console is ready to go . That might include freeing up storage space for the massive 212GB game . You’ll probably also want to get a controller ready for the challenge.
However, GTA 6 continues the trend of games getting more expensive, and its $80 price tag doesn’t leave a lot left over for a fancy new controller such as the limited edition GTA 6 DualSense Controller . However, there are some things you can do to your current controller to ensure it’s ready to explore Leonida.
Some of these upgrades don’t require much work to add on or install. Others will need some more work, including soldering and tinkering with the controller — things that will absolutely void any manufacturer warranties and could end up breaking it permanently. Just be aware of what you’re getting into before attempting the more complicated ones.
Thumbstick caps are a great, low-cost way to give your controller a pretty solid upgrade. In general, for FPS games like Call of Duty, most pro gamers prefer shorter, concave left thumbsticks for quicker movement and taller, concave right thumbsticks for tighter aiming. Many pro controllers include additional thumbstick sizes that you can easily swap out, but you can also get third-party thumbstick caps to give you a similar effect on any controller.
You can go as simple as some rubber grips like these from Skull and Co or these KontrolFreek caps for a bit more stability. My personal favorite is these Ascend caps from Elo Gaming . They snap onto your joysticks very securely and give me lots of extra control. They are a bit difficult to take off, however, so I’d recommend putting them on a spare controller if you have one and just leaving them on.
They’re also a great way to add some extra grip. Thumbsticks will smooth out over time, and thumbsticks on more standard controllers sometimes start off smooth, so adding some caps can quickly give you some more grip, especially if your controller is a bit worn (like mine).
Similar to thumbstick caps, controller grips can add some extra control to your setup, especially if you’re not a huge fan of your controller’s ergonomics. As great as Sony’s DualSense controller is, it’s still not for everyone.
If you just want some extra grip (or have sweaty hands like yours truly), grip tape that wraps around the controller is a great option and won’t cost you a whole lot. There are also full controller covers like these from PlayVital that are better than just grip tape. And for those who want to go all-in, you can step up to a full add-on grip .
Moving around to the back of the controller, there are also some easy ways to upgrade your triggers and bumpers. Every controller manufacturer seems to have a slightly different take on their triggers, and Sony has always made its triggers a bit shorter and wider than Xbox controllers.
Those on Team Blue can quickly and easily add some length and grip to their triggers with the Blade 2 Extension Triggers from PlayVital. If you need some more contoured grip for FPS games, they also have the Dune 2 Trigger Stops . Both options come in multiple colors and run less than $15.
Most pro controllers, including the DualSense Edge , have programmable back paddles. These are essentially extra buttons on the controller that you can remap to any other input. For instance, I often use one to sprint instead of having to always press L3. Much like taller thumbsticks, I personally didn’t think these would be all that useful until I got a controller with them. Now, I can’t use one without them.
There are third-party options you can buy that will give you these extra back paddles without having to modify your controller much. The Strike Pack from Collective Minds snaps onto the back of a regular DualSense controller, and then you can remap the back buttons via a phone app. The extra buttons aren’t true paddles, and to use them you have to plug directly into the PS5, so not wireless, but that’s a small price to pay for not having to buy a whole new controller.

articles.t: GTA 6 et les réseaux : Orange encaisse le pré-téléchargement, Virgin Media bat ses records
articles.chapeau: Le pré-téléchargement de GTA 6 n'a battu aucun record chez Orange, contrairement au Royaume-Uni. Finissez-le avant le déblocage de minuit, le 19.
articles.txt:
Le pré-téléchargement de GTA 6 a fait tomber des records de trafic au Royaume-Uni, mais pas chez Orange . Selon l'opérateur, interrogé par Numerama, son réseau a culminé à environ 19 Tb/s dans la nuit du 9 au 10 novembre , tous usages confondus, alors que son record tourne autour de 23 Tb/s. SFR, Bouygues Telecom et Free n'ont communiqué aucun chiffre.
Orange attribue l'absence de record à la méthode de Rockstar. Le pré-téléchargement s'est ouvert à minuit sur PS5 et à 1 h du matin sur Xbox Series, neuf jours avant la sortie, ce qui laisse le temps d'étaler le téléchargement d'un jeu qui occupe jusqu'à 212 Go selon la console. Toujours selon Orange, une ouverture en soirée, en pleine heure de pointe, aurait donné un résultat très différent. L'opérateur juge d'ailleurs Rockstar plus responsable que l'éditeur de Call of Duty , qui ouvre ses pré-téléchargements à 18 h.
Au Royaume-Uni, Virgin Media O2 a enregistré, le jour de l'ouverture, la plus forte pointe de l'histoire de son réseau fixe britannique, 3,8 % au-dessus du précédent record, établi en mai pendant la demi-finale de Ligue des champions entre Arsenal et l'Atlético de Madrid. Entre minuit et 1 h du matin, l'opérateur a vu passer 51,6 % de trafic de plus que le mardi précédent à la même heure. Le volume de données de la journée a aussi dépassé de 4 % le précédent record, établi neuf jours plus tôt par la mini-saison du chapitre 7 de Fortnite. En Allemagne, un porte-parole de 1&1 a expliqué à l'agence dpa que le trafic des services en ligne PlayStation et Xbox avait atteint par moments environ dix fois celui d'une nuit ordinaire. Vodafone mesurait le mardi matin un débit supérieur d'environ 60 % à celui de la veille.
Aux États-Unis, Comcast s'attend à vivre du 10 au 19 novembre la période la plus chargée de l'histoire de son réseau. Sa marque Xfinity propose à ses abonnés éligibles de passer gratuitement jusqu'à 2 Gb/s pendant quinze jours, une offre à activer dans son application. En France, le seul record connu vient d'OrneTHD, petit opérateur associatif de l'Orne, passé de 74 à 84 Gb/s selon Numerama.
Le déblocage du jeu, à minuit dans la nuit du 18 au 19 novembre sur PS5 comme sur Xbox Series, risque de provoquer un nouveau pic, porté cette fois par les retardataires. Les acheteurs de dernière minute devront télécharger le jeu en entier, y compris en boîte, puisque celle-ci ne contient qu'un code. Les 212 Go passent en une demi-heure sur une fibre à 1 Gb/s, mais il faut près de deux jours sur une ligne ADSL à 10 Mb/s.
Mieux vaut donc terminer son pré-téléchargement avant le 18 au soir , en laissant cochées les entrées annexes du menu de téléchargement de la PS5 . Pour que le téléchargement avance pendant la nuit, la PS5 doit rester allumée ou en mode repos. Dans ce second cas, l'accès à Internet doit rester activé dans les réglages d'économie d'énergie. Une fois installé, GTA 6 se joue entièrement en solo, puisqu'il sort sans mode en ligne au lancement .

articles.t: Welcome to 'Grandthropic', the day the gaming and AI industries get tested
articles.chapeau: Anthropic's IPO and the Grand Theft Auto 6 launch share a Thursday, turning the day into a high-stakes test for AI and gaming.
articles.txt:
Anthropic's IPO and "Grand Theft Auto VI" drop the same day. Rockstar Games; iStock; Tyler Le/BI 2026-11-16T11:44:27.348Z Read in app Copy link Email Facebook WhatsApp X LinkedIn Bluesky Threads lighning bolt icon An icon in the shape of a lightning bolt. Impact Link Save Saved Listen to this story This story is available exclusively to Business Insider subscribers. Become an Insider and start reading now. Have an account? Log in . Grand Theft Anthropic. GTA VI(PO). Grandthropic. Call it whatever you want. Just don't call it boring.
Grand Theft Auto VI's release and Anthropic's market debut arrive this Thursday. Not since "Barbenheimer" — when "Oppenheimer" and "Barbie" premiered the same weekend — have we had two cultural and business phenomena collide on the same day.
I'll start with Anthropic, since that's the easier sell. A valuation as high as $1.4 trillion with as much as $90 billion raised makes it a behemoth (and potentially record-breaking) IPO. It's also the first major test of investor appetite for a company focused solely on AI .
Then there's GTA. The last installment — GTA V — surpassed $1 billion in sales within the first three days of its release in 2013. It remains a top-selling game to this day, with almost 235 million units sold overall.
GTA VI is already off to a hot start. Presale estimates have reached 12.13 million units, totaling $1.18 billion in revenue, according to SensorTower data .
The impact also extends to companies' PTO calendars . (Or your favorite newsletter writer; I'll be out next week.)
Workforce management tech company UKG said time-off requests for the week of GTA 6's release are up roughly 20% compared to the same week in previous years. Some companies are even leaning into it .
For Anthropic, the fate of the wider AI trade rests on its shoulders. And that was before one of the industry's mascots — Jensen Huang — blew up spectacularly.
Add BI in Google so our reporting is easier to find when you’re searching for what matters.
Add to Preferred Sources The AI giant's public debut represents the cleanest bellwether for AI. This isn't an offshoot of the AI ecosystem, like a chipmaker or data center, or a company leveraging AI atop a mature business. Anthropic is as pure-play of an AI company as you'll ever find.
Which raises the question: If investors don't support Anthropic, why have any confidence in the wider AI trade? I argued that point on my Instagram .
For GTA 6, it's tough to compare it to the rest of the video game industry because its incredible success makes it an outlier. But with the threats posed by artificial intelligence and high hardware costs , GTA's success could serve as the anchor that keeps gamers engaged, bridging to other games.
As if that wasn't enough pressure, waiting 13 years for a new edition also created lofty expectations. (And an incredible meme: We got X before GTA 6. )
Strauss Zelnick , CEO and chairman of Take-Two Interactive, the company behind GTA, is well aware of that. At BI's The Long Play event last month, he spoke to my colleague Sarah E. Needleman about how his company's mission "is to make the best entertainment on Earth." The full interview is worth a watch .

articles.t: L’histoire de GTA 6 pourrait durer environ 50 heures, et obtenir le platine, près de 200 heures
articles.chapeau: Le trophée de platine de Grand Theft Auto VI sur PlayStation 5 pourrait nécessiter environ 200 heures, campagne principale comprise.
articles.txt:
MobiDevices.com Logiciels L’histoire de GTA 6 pourrait durer environ 50 heures, et obtenir le platine, près de 200 heures 16.11.2026 à 14:42 L’histoire de GTA 6 pourrait durer environ 50 heures, et obtenir le platine, près de 200 heures Vadim Zaretskiy 3 min Audio 185 Suivre MobiDevices Ajoutez sur Google Source préférée Le trophée de platine de Grand Theft Auto VI sur PlayStation 5 pourrait nécessiter environ 200 heures, campagne principale comprise. Cette estimation a été publiée par Tom Henderson, d’Insider Gaming, qui s’appuie sur des informations de personnes ayant déjà joué à GTA 6 .
Selon Henderson, la campagne principale compte cinq chapitres et près de 100 missions. Il estime qu’il faudra environ 50 heures pour terminer l’histoire sans les missions secondaires. En février, Rob Nelson, codirecteur de Rockstar North, a consacré 80 heures à sa partie. Comme l’a rapporté le New York Times, il a terminé l’histoire principale et accompli une partie des missions facultatives qui influent sur la narration.
Parmi les conditions d’obtention du platine, Henderson cite le scan de 170 espèces d’animaux sauvages dans l’État de Leonida. Selon lui, certains trophées pourraient dépendre d’événements aléatoires dans le jeu, et le temps nécessaire pour les obtenir variera donc. Rockstar Games n’a encore confirmé ni les conditions d’obtention du platine ni la durée de la campagne.
GTA 6 sortira le 19 novembre 2026 à minuit, heure locale, sur PlayStation 5 et Xbox Series X|S.

articles.chapeau: GTA 6, le jeu vidéo le plus attendu de la décennie, doit sortir ce jeudi 19 novembre à minuit (heure française). L'occasion pour certains fans de la saga la plus vendue de l'histoire de prendre des décisions radicales pour pouvoir profiter au mieux de ce jeu légendaire. Des comportements qui peuvent...
articles.txt:
GTA 6, le jeu vidéo le plus attendu de la décennie, doit sortir ce jeudi 19 novembre à minuit (heure française). L'occasion pour certains fans de la saga la plus vendue de l'histoire de prendre des décisions radicales pour pouvoir profiter au mieux de ce jeu légendaire. Des comportements qui peuvent étonner certains autres joueurs. C'est l'une des sorties les plus attendues du monde des jeux vidéo: ce jeudi 19 novembre à minuit ( dans la nuit de mercredi à jeudi ), GTA 6 sera enfin disponible en France. Après 13 ans d'attente, le nouveau volet de la saga Grand Theft auto , où vous incarnez un (ou une aussi cette fois) gangster dans une ville américaine fictive largement inspirée dans cet opus de Miami et ses environs, fait sensation : plus de 12 millions de précommandes ont déjà été effectuées à l'échelle planétaire.
Avant même sa sortie, le jeu vendu à 80€ en moyenne a déjà généré 1,2 milliard de dollars environ, alors qu'il est déjà disponible à l'achat, sans possibilité encore de pouvoir jouer. Les joueurs eux, sont sur le pied de guerre et s'organisent pour pouvoir découvrir le plus rapidement GTA 6 et ses deux héros, Jason et Lucia , qui évolueront cette fois à Vice City, ville inspirée de Miami donc, dans l'état fictif de Leonida, largement inspiré de la Floride.
Cyril, 36 ans, fixe des yeux le compteur qui défile sur sa télé. Dans quelques jours il pourra appuyer sur le bouton "jouer" et il se prépare en avance pour ce jeudi 19 novembre à 00h: "J'essaie de me coucher plus tard, de me réveiller plus tard histoire de ne pas tomber de fatigue jeudi dans la nuit après 1h30 de jeu. J'ai commencé à faire des courses, acheter du Red Bull, des fruits des yaourts et des barres chocolatées", confie cet éducateur spécialisé sur RMC Story .
"Je vais faire des pauses toilettes, des pauses douches, peut-être des pauses sommeil avec des petites siestes", ajoute-t-il. Sa femme et son fils de 8 mois vont aller chez ses beaux-parents pendant 2 jours: "Elle a un peu les boules d'aller chez sa mère pour 36h-48h mais c'est quelque chose que j'ai négocié et demandé il y a longtemps", confie Cyril qui l'assure, il compte bien reprendre une vie normale après ce long week-end à jouer même s'il rêve déjà du jeu la nuit.
D'autres ont investi pour la sortie du jeu. Sylvain chef d'entreprise dans le Maine-et-Loire a refait son bureau, l'a repeint, mis des posters de toutes les sagas GTA sous verre et a fait quelques achats: "J'ai une nouvelle télé spéciale 'gaming', un bureau pour l'accueillir et les manettes qui ne vont pas tarder à arriver. En termes de frais on est sur quelques centaines voire milliers d'euros", assure-t-il sur RMC alors qu'il a repensé sa salle de 'gaming' spécialement pour l'arrivée de GTA 6 .
"Quand on est fan on est fan: on peut être fan de foot et payer des places dans un stade très cher, payer une licence et ces crampons. Moi, c'est GTA ma passion, c'est un investissement", ajoute Sylvain.
Pour pouvoir savourer les premières heures de jeu, jeudi, en pleine semaine, Greg a même posé des jours de congés: "J'ai pour objectif de poser le jeudi et le vendredi et peut-être le lundi et le mardi. J'aurais au moins 4 jours de posés, pour me mettre vraiment à fond dans le jeu. Je travaille toute l'année et je fais un peu ce que je veux de mes congés". Comme Greg près de 10% des joueurs disent avoir prévu de poser au moins jour de congé selon une étude.
Aux États-Unis il y a même une avalanche de congés qui ont été posés ce jeudi. Une division de l'armée américaine a même proposé 4 jours de permission à ses soldats pour y jouer en échange de leur réengagement. "D'autres sociétés ont donné des jours de vacances à leurs salariés, c'est un phénomène incroyable de pop culture", explique sur le plateau d' Apolline Matin Julien Villedieu, président et fondateur de "Level link partners", cabinet de conseil dans l’industrie du jeu vidéo.
L'éducateur Abel Boyi, sociétaire des Grandes Gueules , attend lui aussi la sortie de GTA 6 avec impatience: "C'est l'événement culturel de l'année, c'est tellement immersif, une ville entière est modélisée. C'est le moment que tous les gamers attendent, c'est un peu notre dernier plaisir dans cette société", confie-t-il reconnaissant qu'il existe des risques d'addiction chez certains joueurs.

articles.t: 'GTA 6': 3 intriguing new details we just learned
articles.chapeau: That's a lot of birds.
articles.txt:
At this point, there's a good chance anyone reading this has already purchased and pre-loaded Grand Theft Auto VI . You've chosen a console , or maybe you're still looking to buy one , but at any rate, all you can do is wait for the game and soak in any pre-release details you can.
Thank goodness for The Guardian , then, as the UK newspaper published an exclusive preview of the game in its Saturday print edition. We've read the whole thing, which involved a tour through Vice City's open world in the early stages of the game, and have compiled three of the more fascinating details that were revealed in the piece for your reading pleasure.
One tiny nugget in the preview that stood out immediately is that, apparently, the player can keep a logbook of different wildlife they encounter in the streets and swamps of Leonida. As far as I know, this is a first for Grand Theft Auto , and it feels like something right out of Red Dead Redemption . Nature has been featured in some previous GTA games, but the player didn't have much of a relationship with it, unlike Rockstar's cowboy series.
Anyway, Rockstar confirmed to The Guardian that there are 62 different types of birds to log in GTA6 . That's so many birds, man.
Much of GTA 6 's marketing has focused on the romantic interplay between protagonists Jason and Lucia. We already know that both are playable, and can be switched between freely for much of the game outside of story missions. Rockstar has also spoken to some extent about the way romance works in GTA 6 , but The Guardian's preview shed more light on how the player will actually affect it outside of cutscenes.
Specifically, whoever the player is controlling can call or text the other protagonist when they aren't together. When they are together, the player can make them go on dates, which can take the form of getting drinks, going to the gym, or even robbing a liquor store. Love manifests in many different ways, I guess. There will also be some unspecified consequences for neglecting the relationship, according to the preview.
This was perhaps the most vague part of The Guardian's piece, but also the most interesting. According to Rockstar, GTA 6 "provide mechanisms to encourage [empathy]" in the player. We don't yet know exactly how that will manifest in-game, but it would be a stark departure from the almost nihilistic crime spree fantasies from previous GTA games.
Of course, you can still play GTA 6 that way if you want, but the game might have something for those of us who aren't interested in causing mayhem, too. Recommended deals for you HBO Max — top pick for premium content

Alex has spent most of the last decade reviewing games, smartphones, headphones, and laptops, and he doesn’t plan on stopping anytime soon. He is also a Pisces, a cat lover, and a Kansas City sports fan. Alex can be found on Bluesky at yelix.bsky.social .

articles.t: GTA 6 ‘Free Download’ Trap Targets Crypto Wallets Days Before Launch
GTA 6 Release Date, Time and What to Know
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 launches on November 19. Xbox One players can also stream it at launch, while the campaign is reportedly around 50 hours long.
articles.txt:
After more than a decade of waiting, Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally days away. Rockstar Games is preparing to take players back to Vice City, this time with Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos at the centre of a crime story that looks set to be one of the biggest gaming releases in years.
But with launch day approaching, there are a few practical questions worth answering. When exactly can you start playing? How much storage will you need? Which consoles will run the game? And should you expect to spend an entire weekend completing the story, or several weeks working towards that elusive platinum trophy?
Whether you've already pre-ordered GTA 6 or are still deciding which edition to buy, here's everything you need to know before the game arrives.
GTA 6 launches worldwide on Thursday, November 19, 2026, for PlayStation 5 , Xbox Series X , and Xbox Series S.
Rockstar is using a midnight local-time release, meaning players can start playing when the clock strikes 12:00 a.m. on November 19 in their respective regions.
For players in Nigeria, that means GTA 6 becomes playable at 12:00 a.m. WAT on Thursday, November 19. You won't need to wait until the game unlocks in the United States or another region before getting started.
Because Rockstar is rolling out the game according to local time zones, the launch will happen at different moments around the world.
The important thing is that you don't have to convert another country's launch time to figure out when you can play. Your local midnight is the one that matters.
One thing you probably don't want to be doing on launch night is waiting for a massive download to finish.
Thankfully, Rockstar has opened preloading ahead of release. Players can download the game before November 19, so the files are already on their consoles when the game unlocks.
The preload requires up to 212GB of available storage, depending on the platform. That's a substantial amount of space, so it is worth checking your console storage now rather than deleting games in a hurry on launch day.
PS5 preloading began at midnight local time on November 10. while Xbox Series X|S preloading started at 12:00 a.m. GMT on the same date.
One thing to remember: downloading the game early does not mean you can play it early. The game remains locked until the official release time.
For now, GTA 6 is coming to two console families: PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.
That means owners of the original PlayStation 4 and Xbox One won't be able to install and play the game natively. Despite the game's size and the growing popularity of cloud gaming, there is no confirmed Xbox One Cloud Gaming version to rely on either.
PC players will also have to wait. Rockstar has not announced a PC release date, although a PC version remains something many fans expect could happen eventually.
For now, if you want to play GTA 6 at launch, you'll need a PS5, PS5 Pro, Xbox Series X or Xbox Series S.
This is largely a matter of which console you own and where you prefer to play.
Both platforms are getting the same core single-player experience, so you won't be missing Jason and Lucia's story by choosing one over the other.
However, the PS5 has an advantage worth considering if you enjoy immersive controller features. Rockstar has highlighted the DualSense controller's haptic feedback and adaptive triggers, which should make certain driving, combat and environmental interactions feel more tactile.
The PS5 Pro also comes with additional graphical enhancements, including PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR) and ray-traced shadows.
That doesn't automatically mean you need to buy a PS5 Pro just for GTA 6. It's an expensive upgrade, and the game is expected to run at 30 frames per second on consoles at launch. A standard PS5 or Xbox Series X|S should still give you access to the full experience.
Rockstar is offering two versions of GTA 6: the Standard Edition and the Ultimate Edition.
The Standard Edition costs $79.99, while the Ultimate Edition is priced at $99.99.
The Standard Edition gives you the main game and the pre-order Vintage Vice City Pack, which includes additional cosmetic items.
The Ultimate Edition costs an extra $20 and adds a collection of exclusive content, including special vehicles, weapons, apparel, and other bonuses connected to Jason and Lucia's adventures.

articles.t: Comment jouer à GTA 6 avant tout le monde ? Il existe une astuce simple
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 sort le 19 novembre. Il existe une astuce simple pour y jouer dès le 18, quelques heures avant la sortie officielle.
articles.txt:
GTA 6 sera disponible le 19 novembre à minuit sur PS5 et Xbox Series X/S. De fait, beaucoup de joueurs arpenteront Vice City dès minuit une… mais des petits malins auront déjà quelques heures de jeu dans les pattes. Comment ? Il existe en réalité une astuce simple pour jouer à GTA 6 avant tout le monde. On vous explique.
Cela concerne les Xbox Series X et Xbox Series S. Il faut savoir que le lancement de GTA 6 est mondial, mais pas synchronisé sur un même fuseau horaire. Cela signifie que, partout dans le monde, les serveurs ouvriront à minuit. Or, le premier pays avec boutique en ligne à passer au 19 novembre est la Nouvelle-Zélande (GMT+13). Les joueurs du pays des Hobbits seront donc les premiers servis… mais il n’est pas nécessaire d’y habiter pour en profiter.
Sur votre Xbox Series européenne ou nord-américaine, il est possible de tricher un peu, et vous pouvez le faire en deux minutes. Il suffit d’aller dans les paramètres système , de sélectionner la langue et la région, puis de choisir la Nouvelle-Zélande. En procédant ainsi, vous pourrez lancer votre aventure dès le 18 novembre (mercredi) à midi, heure française, soit douze heures avant la sortie officielle en France !
Cette manipulation est simple et sans réelle conséquence. Microsoft donne officiellement la possibilité de changer la région de sa console, notamment en cas de déménagement. Toutefois, le constructeur s’accommode de cette souplesse et laisse volontiers les joueurs lancer un titre très attendu avant tout le monde. C’est le cas pour tous les jeux qui sortent sur la plateforme… et donc pour GTA 6 . Bien entendu, cela signifie aussi que des spoilers pourront circuler sur le Net avant même la sortie officielle en France. Prudence sur les réseaux sociaux, donc.
Et sur PS5 ? Les choses sont un peu différentes. Si Microsoft applique un zonage au niveau de ses consoles, Sony a choisi de le faire au niveau des comptes PSN. Si votre compte est basé en France, vous aurez beau changer la langue de la console, voire déménager en Nouvelle-Zélande, le jeu restera bloqué jusqu’à minuit. Il faut créer un compte néo-zélandais et avoir une carte bancaire du pays.
GTA 6 est un véritable événement planétaire et certains seraient prêts à tout pour grappiller ne serait-ce que quelques heures de jeu. De là à acheter exprès une Xbox, il n’y a qu’un pas… En tout cas, l’économie mondiale risque de ralentir à la fin de la semaine. Comme le signalait Remote, les congés posés dans le monde ont augmenté de 32 % pour le 19 novembre. Tout de même !

articles.t: GTA6 : Comment Rockstar a construit le monde de GTA inspiré de la Floride ? GTA6 : Comment Rockstar a construit le monde de GTA inspiré de la Floride ?
articles.chapeau: Leonida, l'État américain fictif basé sur la Floride, a été méticuleusement assemblé par les développeurs au cours d'une décennie.
articles.txt:
GTA 6 peut désormais être pré-installé sur consoles, et quelques jours séparent les propriétaires de consoles de jeux du moment où ils pourront commencer à explorer de loin la plus grande carte de jeu que Rockstar n’ait jamais créée.
Leonida, l’État américain fictif basé sur la Floride, a été méticuleusement assemblé par les développeurs au cours d’une décennie. Cela a commencé par des voyages d’études à Miami dès 2015. Aujourd’hui, certains des principaux développeurs impliqués dans la conception du jeu ont mis en lumière leur processus dans une interview accordée au Guardian . Rob Nelson, un développeur principal du jeu, a déclaré : « [Vous voyez] les endroits physiques où vous voulez faire évoluer les personnages, les expériences que vous voulez qu’ils vivent, et la juxtaposition entre les extrêmes de la société qui se trouvent à Miami. »
Interrogé par l’ancienne journaliste de jeux vidéo Keza MacDonald pour savoir si les équipes avaient pu rester incognito, Nelson a répondu : « Nous sommes toujours à moitié incognito, mais si vous avez une bande de geeks qui parcourent un quartier terrifiant, vous vous faites un peu remarquer. » La création du monde a impliqué des fins de nuit dans des boîtes de Miami, des patrouilles en voiture avec des policiers de South Beach, des visites sur des champs de courses et l’exploration des bars étranges des Keys de Floride (qui se trouvent être certains de nos endroits préférés au monde).
À la question de savoir si GTA explorerait un jour un jeu en dehors des États-Unis, Nelson répond « il ne faut jamais dire jamais », mais affirme qu’il reste encore tant de choses à explorer dans les États-Unis d’Amérique, à la fois bizarres et merveilleux. « Je pense que nous sommes tous des étrangers par rapport à cette version de l’Amérique », a-t-il ajouté. « Peu importe où vous habitez… personne ne fait l’expérience de l’Amérique que nous dépeignons ici dans toute sa plénitude. »
GTA 6 sort le 19 novembre sur les consoles Xbox Series S|X et PS5.

articles.t: 'GTA 6' Story Campaign Could Take 50 Hours, While 100% Completion May Need 200
articles.chapeau: Find out how long "GTA 6" takes to beat, from its 50-hour story campaign to an estimated 200 hours for 100% completion and the Platinum Trophy.
articles.txt:
With " Grand Theft Auto 6 " approaching its highly anticipated release, players are already making plans for their return to Vice City and the wider state of Leonida. Some have even arranged time off work to experience Rockstar Games' next open-world adventure without interruptions.
However, finishing the main storyline may be only the beginning.
According to information reported by Insider Gaming, "GTA 6" could take approximately 50 hours to complete its main campaign, while players aiming for the Platinum Trophy or full completion may need at least 200 hours.
With nearly 100 missions, five reported story chapters, animal research, and potentially luck-based achievements, the next "Grand Theft Auto" could demand a considerable time investment.
Rockstar Games Players primarily interested in the campaign may need to set aside considerably more time than they would for a typical action-adventure game.
Insider Gaming reports that the "GTA 6" main story could take approximately 50 hours to finish, based on information gathered from people familiar with the game. The reported campaign consists of nearly 100 missions divided into five chapters.
If accurate, this would give the game a substantial narrative experience, with plenty of opportunities to explore its characters, locations, and interconnected storylines.
If you're planning to complete the campaign during a week-long vacation, the estimated duration could present a challenge.
Reaching the end would require roughly seven hours of gameplay every day, assuming a consistent schedule and minimal time spent on optional activities.
Of course, the actual completion time will depend on individual playstyles, difficulty, exploration habits, and how quickly players progress through missions.
Finishing the campaign is one thing, but completing everything Rockstar Games has to offer is an entirely different undertaking.
According to Insider Gaming, players pursuing the Platinum Trophy on PlayStation 5 or the reported Mythic achievement could spend at least 200 hours working toward full completion.
That estimate is significantly higher than the reported 50-hour campaign length because completionists may need to accomplish additional objectives beyond simply finishing story missions.
These requirements could include earning gold medals in missions, discovering collectibles, completing optional activities, and exploring different aspects of Leonida.
For players who enjoy checking every achievement off a list, this $80 game could provide weeks of additional gameplay after the main story ends.
One particularly interesting reported requirement involves wildlife research.
Players may need to study approximately 170 animal species to achieve full completion. This would resemble the wildlife observation mechanics found in "Red Dead Redemption 2."
Rockstar's previous open-world title placed considerable emphasis on its animal ecosystem. Players could encounter different species, observe their behavior, track them, and add discoveries to an in-game compendium.
If "GTA 6" adopts a similar system, exploring Leonida's wildlife could become a vital part of the completion process.
The setting offers plenty of possibilities, from urban animals in Vice City to wildlife inhabiting swamps, forests, and coastal environments. Tracking every species could require considerable exploration, particularly for players who prefer focusing on the main objectives.
Another potential obstacle involves achievements influenced by random number generation, commonly known as RNG.
Polygon reports that gaming journalist Mike Henderson believes certain "GTA 6" trophies could depend on RNG, potentially involving casino activities and gambling.
If these reports prove accurate, players might encounter achievements that cannot be unlocked simply by following a specific route or completing a fixed number of missions.
Casino-related objectives could require repeated attempts at games of chance, making their completion dependent partly on luck.
This could be particularly frustrating for trophy hunters who prefer predictable achievement requirements. Unlike mission-based challenges, RNG-dependent trophies may require additional time without guaranteeing immediate progress.
However, the exact requirements have not been officially confirmed, so players should treat these details as reported possibilities rather than established features.

Featuring entire animated TV shows, a sprawling world teeming with activities, a romance system at its core, and so much more, there's an abundance of content to keep you immersed in Leonida long before you even attempt to complete the game's main story. Simply put, GTA 6 is unbelievably massive , and unlikely to disappoint those who wish to play nothing but for the foreseeable future.
However, if you are interested in how long it'll take to complete Grand Theft Auto 6's main story , then you're in luck. Details surrounding the game's length, as well as how long it'll take to platinum it, have finally been revealed, giving prospective players an indication of just how long they can expect to embody Jason and Lucia. Of course, this doesn't take into consideration the time it'll take to discover every little secret the game has to offer, but it should offer a ballpark figure of how long the average player can expect to play GTA 6 for.
Lucia aims her pistol in Grand Theft Auto 6. Grand Theft Auto 6 will take players around 50 hours to beat its main story and see the end credits roll. Players can expect to experience nearly 100 main story missions split across five different chapters. This information comes courtesy of sources from the publication Insider Gaming , as well as details and snippets taken from previous leaks as well as official interviews. For example, back in 2025, X user GameRoll revealed in a long list of leaks that the game would have five chapters.
Additionally, in an interview with The New York Times , Rockstar's co-studio head, Rob Nelson, revealed that his latest playthrough had taken 80 hours and contained " some optional goals ." Nearly 100 missions and a 50-hour runtime seem fairly plausible, especially considering that Red Dead Redemption 2 had 109 story missions that took roughly 50 hours to beat. Of course, this information is somewhat subject to change, although if GTA 6's huge file size is anything to go by, fans can likely expect at least 50 hours of story-focused content. Mission lengths will vary, and player skill will prove to be a determining factor in how long it takes each individual to beat the game, but 50 hours seems the most likely length for GTA 6's story based on leaked information and Rockstar's track record.
Jason rides a motorcycle as he runs away from police in GTA 6. If you're looking at platinuming Grand Theft Auto 6 , then you're likely looking at a much longer playtime. Estimates have put a GTA 6 completionist run at around 200 hours, which would be just four hours longer than Red Dead Redemption 2 . Considering just how expansive Grand Theft Auto 6's world is, and the kinds of trophies Rockstar typically implements, it seems extremely likely that it'll take players at least 200 hours to complete absolutely everything on offer.
Of course, this is also subject to change, especially as there are likely to be trophies that require players to locate every kind of a specific object or animal, such as Red Dead Redemption 2's Zoologist trophy. Grand Theft Auto 5 also had a handful of infamously difficult trophies, including Solid Gold, Baby , and Career Criminal , both of which greatly inflated the completionist runtime. So, fans can likely expect similar trophies to appear in Grand Theft Auto 6 .

Ajoutez-nous sur Google La plus grosse fuite de la semaine du lancement de Grand Theft Auto VI ne vient ni d’un pirate informatique ni de CyberLeek, le compte anonyme qui a alimenté les fans en séquences de jeu non officielles pendant des semaines. Elle est sortie de la pochette d’un disque. Un employé de magasin a filmé un exemplaire vinyle de Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, et la liste complète des titres de l’album associé au jeu par Rockstar circulait sur X le même jour. Parmi les noms que personne n’avait annoncés figuraient Dua Lipa , Lana Del Rey, Jennie et Playboi Carti.
On pourrait facilement en conclure que cette liste annonce ce que les joueurs entendront dans les rues de Vice City. Ce serait aller trop loin. Il s’agit de l’album de nouveaux titres que Rockstar a réalisé avec Atlantic Records pour le jeu ; il est distinct des stations de radio du jeu comme de la musique originale composée par Justice. Ce qui a fuité, c’est le produit du label, surprises comprises. La radio, que les joueurs entendront réellement au volant, reste en grande partie un mystère.
Depuis l’annonce de l’album en septembre, les révélations se sont faites au fil des sorties. Six titres ont été dévoilés le jour de l’annonce : des morceaux de Yung Lean avec Future et Metro Boomin, Travis Scott , Morgan Wallen, Rauw Alejandro et Keith Richards, ainsi que la collaboration « Sexy Magic » entre CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso, PinkPantheress, Fred again.. et Étienne de Crécy. « Suzuki » de Fuerza Regida, « Don’t Chart » de Cardi B et « Blood in Your Eyes » de Tove Lo ont suivi, avec « Flower in a Hurricane » de Justice, en collaboration avec Tame Impala, SZA et King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard. Selon le décompte de RockstarINTEL, moins d’une douzaine des 34 titres étaient connus lorsque la pochette a fait surface, et le personnel des disquaires avait indiqué aux fans que la liste resterait confidentielle jusqu’au jour de la sortie.
La pochette montre ce que cette divulgation au compte-gouttes retenait. « Ahh Yea » de Playboi Carti figure en troisième position et « Go Easy » de Dua Lipa en septième. La face C réunit « Power Trip » de Jennie, « Fast Emotion » de Zara Larsson , « Sweet Like Candy » de Camila Cabello et « TRDWFE » de Rina Sawayama. Sur la face D, « Crazy for You » de Lana Del Rey côtoie les titres d’Omar Apollo et Kali Uchis avec Helado Negro. Justice ouvre l’album avec « Starting from Zero », avec Michael McDonald, tandis que Stanley Clarke, Yussef Dayes et Robert Glasper le concluent avec « Overtown Lights ». Aucun de ces noms de la pop n’avait été annoncé. C’est une pochette de disque en magasin qui les a révélés en premier.
Rockstar n’a pas confirmé la liste des titres. PC Gamer rapporte que des sources de Rolling Stone et de Billboard en ont confirmé l’exactitude, tandis que Notebookcheck cite des sources proches du projet. L’indice le plus solide est l’ordre des morceaux : la page de pré-enregistrement de Rockstar plaçait déjà Yung Lean en deuxième position, Travis Scott en quatrième et Keith Richards en 32e ; la pochette confirme ces trois places.
RockstarINTEL apporte deux précisions absentes des autres articles. Le média affirme que « Crazy for You » de Lana Del Rey est un titre inédit réalisé en 2014, et relève que The Weeknd , que l’on peut entendre sur la radio du jeu, ne figure pas sur l’album.

articles.t: GTA 6 Release Times: All The Key Details Xbox Players Need To Know
articles.chapeau: Welcome to launch week!
articles.txt:
It's finally here! We've officially reached the launch week of GTA 6 on Xbox Series X, Xbox Series S, PS5 and even the Xbox One (kind of), 13 long years since the most recent entry in the series back in 2013.
With that in mind, we thought we'd put up a quick release times guide so you know exactly when you can start playing the game, and we've also thrown in a few extra details about what we're expecting for Xbox One players at launch.
The official GTA 6 release date is Thursday, November 19th . You may still see people playing it on Wednesday though, as depending on where you live, certain players will be getting access to it earlier than others.
GTA 6 releases at midnight local time around the world. This means you'll be able to start playing it on Xbox Series X, Xbox Series S and PS5 as soon as November 18th turns into November 19th in your region.
Here's how it all works out based on a Universal Coordinated Time (UTC) time zone, for example:
Technically, yes. Due to the staggered rollout, players in New Zealand will be getting first access to GTA 6 at midnight in their time zone, which equates to 11am on November 18th here in the UK, and even earlier in the United States.
We urge caution around this, as Xbox's terms of service specifically state that you shouldn't switch regions unless you're actually located in the country you're switching to, but we'll leave the decision up to you.
You may have noticed that we didn't mention Xbox One in the release times section up above, and that's because we don't quite know what's happening with it. In a nutshell, Xbox One players will be forced to use Xbox Cloud Gaming in order to get access to GTA 6, which in theory should require buying the game before access is granted.
There are too many unknowns ahead of launch about how this works though. Will cloud access be made available immediately? Will you be able to use the free-with-ads version of the cloud to play GTA 6 , or will it require paying for the service? Is it just Xbox One that you can play it on, or will mobile and PC devices be supported too?
That's where we stand ahead of launch, so while GTA 6 definitely will be playable through the cloud on Xbox One in some form, it's probably best to wait until it's been released before handing over any money as things stand.
Of course, we've already talked about the preload for GTA 6 and how anyone can download the game right now on Xbox Series X and Xbox Series S, regardless of whether they've actually bought it or not.
All that's left is to wait a few more days until the new Grand Theft Auto finally becomes available, and we can't wait to see whether it'll live up to the hype and become a Game of the Year contender when it arrives this Thursday.
Any other questions about the release plans for GTA 6 on Xbox? Leave them in the comments below .

articles.t: What's in the GTA 6 Box? Code, Poster and No Disc Explained
articles.chapeau: The GTA 6 physical edition is a download code, a double-sided poster and an empty disc hub. What's inside, Standard Edition only, region locks and what you lose.
articles.txt:
Open a boxed copy of GTA 6 and you’ll find a download code, a double-sided poster, an upgrade flyer and an empty disc hub. There’s no disc. Rockstar’s support page says it plainly: the physical version contains a download code, and a disc will not be included in the box.
For a series whose boxes once came with fold-out maps of Liberty City and Los Santos, that’s a big shift. Here’s exactly what you get, what you don’t, and what to check before you buy one as a gift.
Unboxing videos from 11 and 12 November, reported by Insider Gaming and Metro, match Rockstar’s description. The PS5 cover carries a “No disc included” notice, and the Xbox box uses similar wording. The box also lists a minimum storage figure of 230 GB, a little above the 212 GB Rockstar quotes for the pre-load, which leaves room for patches.
Every box on the shelf is the Standard Edition. Rockstar says there’s no physical Ultimate Edition. If you want the extra vehicles, weapons and businesses, you redeem the box code and then buy the Ultimate Edition Upgrade from the PlayStation Store or Microsoft Store. Our pre-order guide explains what the upgrade adds.
Rockstar’s physical pre-order list includes the Vintage Vice City Pack but doesn’t mention the free month of GTA+ that digital pre-orders get, so if GTA+ matters to you, digital is the safer bet.
Boxed copies reached retailers from 12 November, and Rockstar says codes work as soon as you have them. Redeem it on your PlayStation or Xbox account and the 212 GB download starts straight away, so a boxed copy bought this week can still be ready for launch. It unlocks at the same moment as a digital copy: midnight local time on 19 November, as our unlock time guide explains. The box doesn’t let you play early.
This is the catch most buyers won’t think about. Rockstar says PlayStation codes are restricted by the region of your PlayStation account, so a PS5 box bought in one country may not redeem on an account registered in another. Xbox codes, Rockstar says, aren’t region-locked. If you’re buying a PS5 copy for someone overseas, or picking one up on holiday, check that the box matches their account region.
Rockstar hasn’t explained the decision beyond saying the physical version supports pre-loading. The practical reasons aren’t hard to guess: a 212 GB game won’t fit on a standard 100 GB Blu-ray, so any disc would have needed a large download anyway. Take-Two chief Strauss Zelnick said on 9 November that any decision on a disc edition is up to Rockstar, and nothing has been announced.
The box still makes a decent gift and looks the part on a shelf. But once the code is redeemed, the game is tied to that account. You can’t lend the box to a friend or trade it in, and you can’t play from it without an internet connection to redeem and download. The poster isn’t the map either: the map that circulated online last week came from merchandise, not from inside the box.
If you’re on PS5, our GTA 6 on PS5 guide covers storage and game sharing, and Xbox One owners should read our cloud gaming guide before buying a box, because there’s nothing to install on that console.

articles.txt:
Add us on Google The biggest Grand Theft Auto VI leak of launch week did not come from a hacker or from CyberLeek, the anonymous account that spent weeks feeding fans unofficial gameplay. It came off the back of a record sleeve. A store employee filmed a vinyl copy of Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, and the full running order of Rockstar’s companion record was spreading on X the same day, with Dua Lipa , Lana Del Rey, Jennie and Playboi Carti among names nobody had announced.
The easy reading is that the list previews what players will hear on the streets of Vice City. That stretches it. The record is the album of new songs Rockstar made with Atlantic Records for the game, and it sits apart from both the in-game radio stations and the original score by Justice. What leaked is the label’s product, surprises included. The radio, the part players will actually hear while driving, is still mostly under wraps.
Since the album was announced in September, the reveal has run one release at a time. Six songs arrived on announcement day, from Yung Lean with Future and Metro Boomin, Travis Scott , Morgan Wallen, Rauw Alejandro, Keith Richards and the ‘Sexy Magic’ collaboration between CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso, PinkPantheress, Fred again.. and Étienne de Crécy. Fuerza Regida’s ‘Suzuki’, Cardi B’s ‘Don’t Chart’ and Tove Lo’s ‘Blood in Your Eyes’ followed, along with Justice’s ‘Flower in a Hurricane’ with Tame Impala, SZA and King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard. By RockstarINTEL’s count, fewer than a dozen of the 34 tracks were public when the sleeve surfaced, and record store staff had been telling fans the list would stay private until release day.
The sleeve shows what the drip was holding back. Playboi Carti’s ‘Ahh Yea’ sits at track three and Dua Lipa’s ‘Go Easy’ at seven. Side C stacks Jennie’s ‘Power Trip’, Zara Larsson ‘s ‘Fast Emotion’, Camila Cabello’s ‘Sweet Like Candy’ and Rina Sawayama’s ‘TRDWFE’, and Lana Del Rey’s ‘Crazy for You’ lands on side D next to Omar Apollo and Kali Uchis with Helado Negro. Justice open the record with ‘Starting from Zero’, featuring Michael McDonald, and Stanley Clarke, Yussef Dayes and Robert Glasper close it with ‘Overtown Lights’. None of those pop names had been announced. A retail sleeve announced them first.
Rockstar has not confirmed the tracklist. PC Gamer reports that Rolling Stone’s sources and Billboard’s have confirmed it as accurate, and Notebookcheck cites sources close to the project. The strongest evidence is the order itself: Rockstar’s own pre-save listing had already slotted Yung Lean at number two, Travis Scott at four and Keith Richards at 32, and the sleeve matches all three.
RockstarINTEL adds two details the other reports do not carry. It says Lana Del Rey’s ‘Crazy for You’ is an unreleased song made in 2014, and it notes that The Weeknd, who can be heard on the in-game radio, is missing from the album.
That missing name points at the real gap. Eurogamer read the sleeve as a guide to the licensed music in the game, but PC Gamer, Dexerto and Notebookcheck all separate the album from the radio, which will carry its own licensed catalogue. What is public about the stations is a list of hosts rather than playlists: Notebookcheck reports Bad Bunny on Cocoteo FM, Burna Boy and Palms Trax on AfroBank FM, and Morgan Wallen and Lana Del Rey on Back Country Radio. None of the reports says where the album’s songs will sit inside the game, in a mission, a cutscene or a station rotation.
The leak also fits the pattern of this launch. Eurogamer notes that the game’s full map seemingly leaked through the collector’s edition on show in a UK department store. Two of the biggest late leaks have now come off a shop floor rather than out of a studio, as physical stock reaches retailers ahead of release.
The album is due on November 19, the same day Grand Theft Auto VI launches on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, though RockstarINTEL reports a one-day slip to November 20. It will be on streaming services, CD and vinyl. According to Notebookcheck, Rockstar’s store lists the CD at $19.98 and the standard vinyl at $49.98, while a $124.98 limited vinyl with liquid-filled discs sold out within minutes of going on pre-order. Justice’s original score is a separate 30-track album due on December 11. The game costs $80 for the standard edition and $100 for the Ultimate Edition, and there is still no PC date.

Recevez tous les soirs un résumé de l’actu importante avec Le Récap’
Si vous avez grandi avec GTA , alors vous avez forcément passé des heures et des heures à faire n’importe quoi. Dans GTA 3 , je me souviens m’être amusé à utiliser des codes pour obtenir un bazooka et semer le chaos depuis le toit d’un hôpital. De quoi obtenir facilement six étoiles, mais sans craindre de grandes conséquences pour ma partie non plus.
GTA 6 , disponible à partir du 19 novembre sur PS5, Xbox Series S et Xbox Series X , pourrait bien changer la donne de ce point de vue. Les développeurs ont opté pour une approche plus réaliste et plus mature. Rob Nelson, co-directeur du studio Rockstar North et l’un des trois directeurs créatifs du jeu, explique dans un reportage du Guardian paru le 14 novembre que GTA 6 est le premier épisode de la série à encourager l’empathie, du moins chez les joueurs qui le souhaitent. Autrement dit, il faudra davantage faire attention à ce que l’on fait.
GTA 6 // Source : Rockstar Games GTA 6 veut des criminels plus prudents « Le crime est un élément fondamental de GTA — du moins, ça l’a été jusqu’à présent. Nous essayons de faire en sorte de ne pas punir les gens qui jouent comme ils en ont l’habitude… mais vos actions auront un certain effet sur le déroulement de la partie », explique Rob Nelson. Sur cette notion d’empathie, il indique : « Je dirais que c’est le fruit de l’histoire que nous essayons de raconter. Pour la première fois dans un GTA, nous avons essayé de proposer des mécaniques qui encouragent cela, pour ceux qui le souhaitent. »
Cette empathie passe d’abord par le couple formé par Jason et Lucia. Le Guardian, qui a vu le jeu tourner dans les locaux de Rockstar North à Édimbourg, raconte que le joueur peut les faire s’appeler et s’écrire quand ils sont séparés. Il peut aussi les emmener en rendez-vous (salle de sport, bar, retraite de méditation… ou braquage de supérette), et même leur faire se tenir la main d’une pression sur un bouton. Négliger cette relation aura des conséquences, car elle est « à entretenir ou à perdre ».
Rien ne dit pour autant que je puisse prendre un bazooka et tout faire exploser comme avant sans que la suite de la partie s’en ressente, même si Rob Nelson assure ne pas vouloir punir ceux qui jouent à l’ancienne. En ce sens, GTA 6 se rapproche bien plus de Red Dead Redemption 2 que de GTA 5 . Le Guardian note d’ailleurs que le jeu s’inspire largement du western de Rockstar sorti en 2018. Les amatrices et amateurs de défouloir pur et dur pourraient donc déchanter, si le réalisme prend le pas sur l’amusement.
Par exemple, le vol de voitures se débloquera progressivement. Au début du jeu, Jason et Lucia ne pourront démarrer que des voitures bas de gamme et crocheter des serrures basiques, les coups plus juteux venant plus tard. « Ces deux personnages forment un jeune couple dos au mur », justifie Rob Nelson. Il ajoute : « D’un point de vue narratif, cela n’aurait pas de sens de les laisser aller dehors et de causer autant de carnage et de bruit que possible . »
Les braquages de GTA 6 suivent la même logique. Plutôt que de sortir un fusil d’assaut en pleine rue, il faudra repérer sa cible (station-service ou boutique de luxe), couper les caméras ou voler les enregistrements, trouver une porte dérobée ou le code du coffre, puis filer avant l’arrivée des témoins. Sans ces précautions, la situation dégénère vite.

GTA 6 is 50 hours long claims leak but 100% completion will take longer
articles.chapeau: GTA 6's map was already described as being twice as big as GTA 5's and it's claimed the same goes for a 100% playthrough.
articles.txt:
Ahead of GTA 6 ’s launch this week, estimates for how long the game’s main story and 100% completion will take have been leaked.
Everyone already knows that GTA 6 is going to be an incredibly big game, both culturally and literally, with Rockstar stating that the map is twice as big as GTA 5’s – which wasn’t exactly small to begin with.
Combined with how much there’ll be to see and do , GTA 6 won’t be something you can easily beat over the weekend, although it seems you will be get quite a way through, if you don’t get distracted by side quests and explorations.
There have been lots of questions about precisely how long it will take to complete GTA 6 and while the answer obviously varies from person to person, new estimates have been shared ahead of launch.
According to Insider Gaming’s Tom Henderson , who cites ‘people who have actual knowledge of the game’s length,’ GTA 6’s main story should take an average of 50 hours to finish.
Sign up to the GameCentral newsletter for the latest GTA 6 news, reviews of new games you should play and exclusive analysis of the biggest stories of the week.
As a reminder, Rockstar North’s own head of development, Rob Nelson, said earlier this year that his then most recent playthrough took him 80 hours, although this included ‘optional goals with narrative ramifications.’
While it sounds like some side quests can have an impact on the main storyline, them being optional means you can still skip them if you just want to hit the credits ASAP.
But what if you were to do every side quest, though, as well as earn every PlayStation trophy or Xbox achievement for 100% completion? Current rumours put GTA 6’s trophy/achievement count at 55, which is slightly more than the 51 that GTA 5 had at launch.
In a post on X , Henderson claims that 100% completion could take over 200 hours, adding, ‘I hope you like animals!’ This suggests GTA 6 will have something like Red Dead Redemption 2 ’s Zoologist trophy, which required you to study every animal in the game. And GTA 6 is expected to have a lot of those, both in the wild and in zoos.
The latest GTA game has been a long time coming. (Picture: Metro/Grand Theft Auto)
After more than a decade of anticipation, Rockstar Games' highly anticipated Grand Theft Auto 6 launches on November 19, taking players back to the neon-soaked streets of Vice City.
Set in the sprawling state of Leonida, heavily inspired by Florida, the open world adventure follows dual protagonists Jason and Lucia in what promises to be the biggest and most immersive GTA game yet.
In case you’re wondering, HowLongToBeat estimates that an average GTA 5 playthrough, where you focus only on the story, takes just 32 hours to finish, while going for 100% takes roughly 89½ hours. Although we doubt anyone playing the game normally has actually completed it that quickly naturally.
If you take all these estimates at face value, then GTA 6 is more than twice as big as GTA 5. Considering GTA 6 will be the only video game some people will be playing this year, they’re certainly getting their money’s worth.
This should also keep players occupied until GTA 6’s online multiplayer launches. Although Rockstar’s still not formally announced it, it’s expected to arrive some time next year and allow for user generated content à la Roblox .

articles.chapeau: Grand Theft Auto VI is finally almost here, but if you don't want to spend the money to get it, there's a chance you'll still be able to play.
articles.txt:
By James Lynch Published Nov 16, 2026, 5:33 AM EST James is a gaming writer from London who has spent thousands of hours exploring titles from every genre. Though he has a particular affinity for multiplayer titles like World of Warcraft, Destiny 2 and League of Legends, he has also put thousands of hours into single-player experiences, from deep RPGs to epic PC strategies. When he's not playing or writing, he can usually be found supporting his beloved Brentford FC. Sign in to your ScreenRant account It's actually kind of hard to believe that Grand Theft Auto VI is finally almost here, after years of excitement, delays, and speculation about what it is all going to be like. However good it does end up being, there's very little doubt that it's going to be an enormous commercial success for Rockstar, not least because so many are going the extra mile and buying the $100 Ultimate Edition.
That said, getting your hands on the game for the November 19 release date simply won't be possible for everyone given its premium pricing, and that's undoubtedly a shame when it feels like such a monumental moment for gaming culture. Interestingly, if you are a little tentative about spending that kind of money, there are two official giveaways that are about to go ahead that are set to give thousands of players a copy, entirely for free.
Lucia aims her pistol in Grand Theft Auto 6. As first reported by ComicBook, there are two massive code giveaways taking place to celebrate the launch of GTA VI, all in conjunction with the streaming platforms Kick and Twitch. As is often the case with these kinds of things, it all centers on you heading over to your chosen platform and watching people play games, which sounds like quite a lot of fun in and of itself.
In the case of Kick, all you need to do is watch three hours (180 minutes) of live streams, which in turn rewards viewers with a Kick Sunset Reward case. Open it, and there's a chance that it will contain a code for the Ultimate Edition of GTA VI , though the company haven't gone as far as disclosing the odds of that happening. In total, there are 10,000 codes available for the platform, though, which will be drip fed to players until the event draws to a close on December 7.
Twitch is a similar situation, though the giveaway there isn't set to start until the game launches on November 19, and it will only be running until November 30. The details around numbers and which edition of the game players will be getting for watching on the platform haven't been disclosed yet, but it's likely to be at least as many as we're seeing over on Kick.
Jason and Lucia in all black SWAT gear GTA 6. It's worth remembering (if watching live streams isn't really your usual thing) that watch hours register the same even if the content is muted. That should allow you to have it quietly ticking away in the background, entering you into the draw while at the same time allowing you to go about your day as normal.
Again, getting involved in the competition is far from a sure thing, even though there will be tens of thousands of codes available across both platforms. There will be millions of potential entrants, but it does present an opportunity, however small it is, to play Grand Theft Auto VI without spending money many out there simply don't have. Failing that, there will be plenty of handy sales on the game further down the line, so everyone should get their turn with it eventually.

articles.chapeau: All the GTA 6 release info you need
articles.txt:
Probably the most anticipated game of all time, GTA 6 is now less than one week away!
As the launch draws even closer, we're covering absolutely everything you need to know about its PS5 launch, including preload options and release times. In this GTA 6 guide , we cover the GTA 6 release times .
Rockstar has confirmed GTA 6 will officially be playable from midnight on 19th November in your local time zone. If you have preloaded the game, it'll unlock at midnight, and then you can begin playing immediately.
As such, the game will unlock and be available first in New Zealand. Availability will then roll out worldwide as each time zone reaches midnight on 19th November.
GTA 6 preload is available now ! If you've pre-ordered from the PS Store, your download of the game should have started and will then be ready for you to start playing at release.
Rockstar has now officially confirmed the GTA 6 file size on PS5, and what you'll need to download, is 212GB . This is one of the biggest downloads and installs on console in history, and will probably only get bigger through patches and the addition of GTA Online.
GTA 6 will unlock and be playable in New Zealand first, as it's located in one of the furthest along timezones. The chances are New Zealand is further along in the day compared to wherever you live in the world, so yes, New Zealand will be the first to gain access to GTA 6.
Because of this, there's been a rising trend in people creating New Zealand PSN account to play games as soon as possible. This can be done with GTA 6 too, but you'll need to set up a fresh New Zealand PSN account and buy the game through its PS Store.
When you have done, you'll be able to play GTA 6 a few hours ahead of other countries like the USA. Keep in mind, though, that you can't transfer your save data from the New Zealand account you set up to your normal profile.
GTA 6 is available digitally on the PS Store, or in a basic physical version that ships without a disc. The latter provides a code in the box that you redeem on the PS Store to get the digital version.
The two PS5 digital versions on offer are: Standard Edition and Ultimate Edition .
Rockstar is only selling GTA 6 in a digital format; you can't buy the game on a physical disc in any way. Even the version you buy in retail shops or from online retailers won't contain a disc. Instead, the actual GTA 6 box will have a code inside you can use to download the game. There's no version with a physical disc of any kind.
Rockstar has now confirmed a GTA 6 map will be made available, but it won't be included in the physical versions like for previous games. Instead, a physical GTA 6 map will be put on the official Rockstar store for $0.99. Or, it'll be included for free in all other purchases from the storefront.

articles.chapeau: Leak after leak is spoiling the Rockstar party. The latest to be outed is the GTA 6 soundtrack list, which was leaked this weekend after images of the vinyl rel
articles.txt:
Copied Leak after leak is spoiling the Rockstar party. The latest to be outed is the GTA 6 soundtrack list, which was leaked this weekend after images of the vinyl release, which had been sold too early, appeared online. Sources then confirmed the list to Rolling Stone. It’s an impressive lineup. GTA VI: The Album has 34 songs, with new music from Lana Del Rey, Dua Lipa and Zara Larsson, among others. For the general public, the Grand Theft Auto soundtrack arrives on Friday, November 20, a day after the game launches digitally.
Some of the tracks were already out. Travis Scott, Morgan Wallen, Keith Richards (“Bright Lights, Big City”), and Justice with Tame Impala and SZA had all been released before the leak.
The leak revealed the rest. Rauw Alejandro, Jennie, Rina Sawayama, Young Thug, Arca, Tove Lo and Playboi Carti are all on the album. Justice, who also scored the game, has a collaboration with Michael McDonald too, which is not a pairing many people would have predicted.
The radio is just as stacked. Lana Del Rey, Morgan Wallen, Bad Bunny, members of Slayer, Burna Boy and Robyn will each DJ their own stations in GTA VI.
Lana Del Rey’s new track is called “Crazy for You.” It shares its name with a song that has been in her unreleased collection for more than a decade.
The singer also explained why the project means so much to her. “One of the coolest things about this is the fact that the first time some of our family got to LA they actually knew the roads because of playing the game,” Del Rey said. She called it “super special and a privilege,” and said she can’t wait to start playing.
The celebrations continue after launch. On November 21, Cardi B, Kodak Black and Don Toliver, all of whom appear on the album, will join Travis Scott and Justice at a one-off Grand Theft Auto 6 music festival in Miami.

articles.t: Selon une fuite, il faut 50 heures pour terminer l'histoire de GTA 6 et 200 heures pour obtenir le trophée de platine sur PS5
articles.chapeau: L’histoire de GTA 6 pourrait être plus courte que ce à quoi certains fans s’attendaient, une fuite concernant un test l’estimant à 50 heures. Malgré tout, les missions secondaires et la chasse aux trophées font rapidement grimper ce chiffre. Le trophée platine sur PS5 exige 200 heures de jeu en solo et une laborieuse chasse aux animaux.
articles.txt:
Insider Gaming a appris grâce à des fuites de tests de GTA 6 combien de temps il faut pour terminer le dernier projet de Rockstar . Sans les activités annexes ni les missions facultatives, les joueurs pourraient terminer l’histoire de Jason et Lucia en 50 heures. Cependant, les joueurs PS5 devront passer bien plus de temps à explorer Leonida pour décrocher le trophée de platine.
L’estimation de Tom Henderson repose sur les impressions de journalistes qui testent le jeu avant la date de sortie de GTA 6 . Il a également indiqué que le titre comptait 100 missions réparties sur les cinq chapitres de la campagne.
Une histoire de 50 heures peut sembler courte par rapport à ce qui avait été évoqué auparavant. Dans une interview accordée au New York Times , Rob Nelson, codirecteur de Rockstar North, a expliqué que sa partie avait duré environ 80 heures. Cela comprenait toutefois des quêtes facultatives dans un vaste monde ouvert où il est facile de se laisser distraire.
La carte de Vice City et de ses environs est nettement plus grande que celle de GTA 5 ou de Red Dead Redemption 2 . Alors que Grand Theft Auto 5 proposait 32 heures d’action en solo, RDR 2 nécessitait environ 50 heures. La possibilité de traverser les régions à bord de puissantes supercars plutôt qu’à cheval pourrait jouer un rôle.
La nouvelle fuite concernant un test de GTA 6 apporte des précisions à un précédent rapport sur les trophées PS5 et les succès Xbox . Pour obtenir le très convoité trophée platine PlayStation, les joueurs devraient prévoir environ 200 heures. Henderson laisse entendre qu’un rare succès mythique Xbox sera disponible.
Une précédente analyse des données avait révélé 55 trophées PS5, dont le platine. De leur côté, les propriétaires de consoles Xbox peuvent s’attendre au même total si un succès mythique est bien présent. Insider Gaming a également révélé que les chasseurs de trophées devront être des amoureux de la nature. Comme dans Red Dead Redemption 2 , les joueurs devront localiser et photographier 170 animaux différents sur l’ensemble de la carte de Leonida.
À noter que tous les objectifs disponibles à la sortie de GTA 6 concernent le mode solo ou l’histoire. On ignore quand une suite de GTA Online pourrait voir le jour, mais la version de lancement contient du code lié aux modes multijoueurs .

articles.txt:
GTA VI’s game length has potentially been leaked by someone given an early copy of the game by Rockstar. SPOILER WARNING: This article contains minor details about GTA VI’s story structure, including its mission count and chapter information. No major story spoilers are included. Info follows the image below.
With GTA VI getting closer to its release, players are already wondering how much time they will need to spend in Leonida to experience everything the game has to offer. While completing the main story alone could take around 50 hours, getting every achievement and trophy is expected to take considerably longer.
According to a new report from Insider Gaming , GTA VI will feature nearly 100 missions spread across five different chapters. Based on information gathered from people who have played the game, completing the main campaign is expected to take approximately 50 hours. This is speculation but given reviewers have their hands in the game right now, it seems likely a reviewer has shared this information with the outlet.
Of course, this number could change depending on how players approach the game. Some may focus entirely on the main missions, while others will spend more time exploring the map and discovering everything Leonida has to offer.
For players who want to get every trophy on PlayStation or unlock all achievements on Xbox, the journey could be much longer. The report estimates that reaching 100% completion could take around 200 hours.
This estimate also brings Rob Nelson’s previous comments to mind. During an interview with The New York Times published in August, Rockstar’s Head of Development and Co-Studio Head revealed that he had spent around 80 hours playing GTA VI back in February. His playthrough included the main story and optional activities that could affect the narrative.
One example of the game’s additional content is its wildlife system. GTA VI reportedly features 170 different wildlife species that players will need to scan to complete this part of the game. This is somewhat similar to the wildlife tracking activities found in Red Dead Redemption 2, which has an estimated full completion time of around 196 hours.
With nearly 100 missions, five chapters and plenty of activities outside the main story, GTA VI looks set to offer a lot of content for players to discover. articles.txt:
Millions of players will start their adventure in Leonida with the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6 later this week. They're currently preparing themselves and completing the games they've left unfinished so they can dedicate all of their time to GTA 6 soon — especially gamers who have asked for time off from work to play it. As it turns out, a week off from work might not be enough. After gathering information from various people who've played the game, Insider Gaming has reported that it should take around 50 hours to get through Grand Theft Auto 6 's campaign . The story is reportedly spread across five chapters and consists of nearly 100 missions.
Cal Hampton Hefts a Mini Golf Putter in Grand Theft Auto 6 Image: Rockstar Games Besides the main story, players can go for GTA 6 's Platinum Trophy or the Mythic achievement. Additionally, Henderson believes that there will be certain trophies that will depend on RNG — likely related to the casino and gambling. So, are you ready to spend hours at the slot machines?
According to one unconfirmed report, GTA 6 will have 55 achievements for players to complete.
As shown in several interviews, teasers, and the extended trailer, there's plenty of side content and optional exploration you can do — even if it's just grabbing a bite to eat, looking at the intricate cloud system, or taking the bus until the end of the line . Therefore, we can conclude that besides the main story and the completionist trophies, players will likely spend far more than 200 hours in Vice City and greater Leonida.

articles.txt:
Une apparition inattendue pourrait bien se profiler pour Jennie ! La membre de BLACKPINK est mentionnée dans une prétendue fuite de la tracklist de l’album officiel de Grand Theft Auto VI, qui circule actuellement en ligne. Selon ce document, la chanteuse aurait contribué au projet avec un morceau inédit intitulé « Power Trip ».
Le 14 novembre, une vidéo montrant le dos d’un exemplaire physique de Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album a commencé à circuler sur les réseaux sociaux. Les images dévoileraient la liste complète des 34 morceaux de l’album, répartis sur les quatre faces d’un vinyle.
Parmi les nombreux artistes mentionnés figurent notamment Dua Lipa, Lana Del Rey, Cardi B, Travis Scott, Camila Cabello, Zara Larsson, Tove Lo et Rina Sawayama. Jennie apparaît également à la 21e position avec un titre intitulé « Power Trip ».
La fuite a rapidement attiré l’attention des fans, d’autant que plusieurs morceaux déjà dévoilés officiellement par Rockstar Games figurent bien sur cette liste. Le nombre total de titres correspond également aux 34 morceaux annoncés par le studio en septembre.
Cette tracklist n’a toutefois pas été publiée officiellement par Rockstar Games ou Atlantic Records. Le document qui circule en ligne semble provenir d’un exemplaire physique de l’album, mais la participation de Jennie et l’existence de « Power Trip » n’ont pas encore été confirmées par les parties concernées.
Plusieurs médias spécialisés ont néanmoins relayé la fuite. That Grape Juice rapporte notamment que des sources citées par Rolling Stone auraient corroboré la tracklist, même si Rockstar n’a pas encore dévoilé l’intégralité des crédits.
Annoncé en septembre dernier en partenariat avec Atlantic Records, Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album doit réunir 34 morceaux originaux inspirés de l’univers du jeu. Les six premiers titres ont déjà été dévoilés officiellement, avec notamment des contributions de Yung Lean, Future, Metro Boomin, Travis Scott, PinkPantheress et Rauw Alejandro.
Si cette fuite se confirme, Jennie pourrait donc rejoindre une impressionnante liste d’artistes internationaux associés au projet, avec un morceau inédit qui serait dévoilé à l’occasion de la sortie de l’album.
